stories.title: Pope Leo ends France trip in Metz, spotlighting Schuman and EU unity
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV ended his four-day visit to France in Metz on Monday by urging Europe to build on its Christian heritage and culture of dialogue rather than succumb to what he called the “desire for domination” behind many of today’s wars.

stories.title: Powerful nor’easter uncovers 19th-century shipwreck on US island
stories.summary: A powerful nor’easter has exposed splintered wooden beams on a Nantucket beach, possibly from a 19th-century shipwreck. Experts will inspect the wreckage, which may be linked to the Warren Sawyer, a schooner lost off Nantucket in 1884.

stories.title: Polo makes landfall in Mexico as Category 3 hurricane, cutting power and causing floods

stories.title: Protesters march for unrestricted abortion access in Chile and Colombia
stories.summary: Demonstrators gathered in Santiago and Bogotá on International Safe Abortion Day, calling for greater access to abortion and defending reproductive rights.

stories.title: At least 81 killed after heavy rain and flooding in northern India, officials say

stories.title: Russia under Putin lost nearly half its schools — war propaganda fills the rest
stories.summary: Closures driven by per-pupil funding that made smaller rural schools unviable far outpaced demographic decline. Since 2022, all remaining schools hold mandatory weekly classes on Russian "traditional values" and the Kremlin's version of events surrounding Russia's war in Ukraine.

stories.summary: A Russian strike hit a nine-storey apartment block in Kharkiv early on Monday, injuring 25 people, including nine children. Emergency workers evacuated 32 residents from the damaged building, according to regional authorities.

stories.summary: Seven complexes holding more than 20,000 inmates are planned for 2035, including one in Russian-occupied Kherson, even as the prison population has dropped from 465,000 to 282,000 since 2021, largely because inmates have been recruited as contract soldiers for the war in Ukraine.

stories.summary: A jet ski rider manoeuvred through flooded streets in Bangkok as days of heavy rain inundated roads, markets and homes.

stories.title: Tigray rebels push into Afar as Ethiopia blames neighbours
stories.summary: The TPLF advanced toward Afdeera after taking Erebti, with at least 150,000 people feared displaced in Afar alone. The offensive targets the Djibouti corridor, through which almost all of Ethiopia's international trade flows, giving the rebels potential leverage over the federal government.
